text:
Aditi Singh: FYI urgent routing request — Tom's candidate (SWE L5) got a counteroffer, wants higher base + split sign-on. Need quick comp exception.
Tom Alvarez: Candidate asking for 175k base, band top is 170k. Manager recommends approving to avoid losing them. Also wants start 2024-06-01.
Aditi Singh: Key asks: +5k above band, $10k sign-on split over 2 months, expedited benefits activation on start. Can comp sign off or route to committee? @Ken Zhao please advise.
Ken Zhao: Quick check — band for L5 is 150k-170k. 175k is >band; needs comp committee approval or VP sign-off depending on rationale. Do we have market data?
Tom Alvarez: We have comp intel — candidate has competing offer at 180k base + 100% bonus. Equity is comparable. Losing them will delay feature launch.
Priya Rao: From People Ops: If committee approves, we can make offer contingent on background and have benefits start on day 1. For split sign-on, finance needs to confirm payroll timing.
Sara Nguyen: Finance — we can do $10k sign-on split: $5k after 1st pay period, $5k after 60 days. Need payroll code and GL. Also need to confirm tax treatment with payroll team.
Aditi Singh: Adding quick offer snippet for review:
```
Role: SWE L5
Base: $175000 (band 150k-170k)
RSU: 120k 4y
Sign-on: $10,000 (split 5k/5k)
Start date: 2024-06-01
Benefits: Day 1 active
```
Ken Zhao: Thanks. Please provide short market note for committee (1-2 bullets) and hiring urgency. I can pull historical approvals if needed.
Tom Alvarez: Market note: candidate has direct competing offer at 180k base; immediate impact: ship ML infra work for Q3. Urgency: high — candidate asked for decision within 48 hours.
Priya Rao: I'll prep the committee packet and flag as expedited. Who should I route to as approvers? (VP Eng, Comp Chair, Finance lead)
Aditi Singh: Route to @VP Eng (L. Martinez), @Ken Zhao (Comp Chair), @Sara Nguyen (Finance lead). Also cc Legal if any unusual terms.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist created: ONB-4567. Benefit enrollment window set to start_date = 2024-06-01.
Ken Zhao: Sending to comp committee now. If they approve, Priya please update offer template and include split sign-on payment schedule.
Priya Rao: Will do. I'll also note the expedited reason in the packet.
Aditi Singh: Thanks everyone. Please post committee response here so we can finalize before candidate deadline. :thumbsup:
Tom Alvarez: Appreciate the quick action.
Sara Nguyen: FYI payroll will need final approval by 5/27 to hit 6/1 benefits.
Aditi Singh: Noted — escalating timeline in packet.
Ken Zhao: Committee scheduled review at 1718201280 (now). Will report back within an hour.
Aditi Singh: Perfect, thanks — keeping candidate on hold until we have decision.
Ken Zhao: Comp committee approved a one-time exception to base to 175k given documented competing offer and business impact. Recording decision and rationale.
Aditi Singh: Great — proceeding to send final offer. Priya will attach the sign-on schedule and Sara, please confirm payroll GL codes.
Priya Rao: Offer sent to candidate with sign-on schedule.
Sara Nguyen: Confirmed GL codes: 6100. Payroll will process first sign-on on first pay run after start.
Tom Alvarez: Candidate verbally accepted. Will sign once offer arrives. Huge win.
Aditi Singh: Closing loop — thanks team. Updating internal tracker ONB-4567 -> status: offer accepted. :tada:
